data.description:
## What
Write RED tests for the arbiter dispatch logic in runner.py.

## Tests to write: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_arbiter.py
1. test_arbiter_dispatched_on_resustain_with_prior_defense: when first_pass_findings contains a finding with relation=RESUSTAIN_OF and a prior defense exists for that finding_id, runner dispatches an additional 'code-reviewer-arbiter' agent call.
2. test_arbiter_not_dispatched_without_prior_defense: when relation=RESUSTAIN_OF but no prior defense, arbiter is NOT dispatched.
3. test_arbiter_not_dispatched_for_new_introduced: when relation=NEW_INTRODUCED, arbiter is NOT dispatched even if prior defense exists.

## Testing mode: RED (functions not yet in runner.py)

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 3 tests FAIL with AttributeError or assertion error (RED state)
- Tests follow behavioral-testing-standard.md
data.title: RED: test runner.py dispatches code-reviewer-arbiter on RESUSTAIN_OF + prior defense
